checks.name: Missing purchase records (orders vs payments)
checks.query: GraphQL: orders(first:100, query:"created_at:>=<yesterday> created_at:<<today>") { nodes { name createdAt test cancelledAt displayFinancialStatus sourceName totalPriceSet{shopMoney{amount}} } }  |  ShopifyQL: FROM payments SHOW gross_payments, transactions GROUP BY payment_gateway, payment_method SINCE -1d UNTIL today
checks.logic: Count of web/draft orders with financial status PAID or PARTIALLY_PAID (not test) must equal count of SALE/CAPTURE payment transactions for the same day (allow +1 for cash on delivery / manual). Sum of order totals within £1 of gross payments.
checks.threshold: Any order without a payment, or any payment without an order

checks.name: Duplicate orders
checks.query: orders(first:100, query:"created_at:>=<-2d>") { nodes { name createdAt totalPriceSet{shopMoney{amount}} lineItems(first:20){nodes{ variant{id} quantity }} } }
checks.logic: Two orders with the same variant set and the same total within 30 minutes (customer identity is NOT read; compare items+amount+time only).

checks.name: Paid-but-cancelled / failed refund / fulfilled-without-payment
checks.query: orders(first:100, query:"updated_at:>=<-2d>") { nodes { name cancelledAt displayFinancialStatus displayFulfillmentStatus transactions{ kind status amountSet{shopMoney{amount}} } } }
checks.logic: FAIL if cancelledAt is set AND financial status PAID (refund missing), or any REFUND transaction with status FAILURE, or fulfilled while financial status EXPIRED/PENDING/VOIDED.
checks.alert: HQ card + daily report + owner push
checks.known_today: #1020 (paid, cancelled, 3 failed PayPal refunds); #1010 and #1014 (fulfilled, payment expired). VERIFIED Stage 1 section 16.

checks.name: Currency errors
checks.source: Shopify Admin GraphQL (daily); GA4 via OpenRush get_website_analytics (weekly, shared with DQ13)
checks.query: orders(...) { nodes { name currencyCode presentmentCurrencyCode } }  |  GA4 property currency from the DQ13 pull
checks.logic: Every order currencyCode and presentmentCurrencyCode = GBP. GA4 reporting currency = GBP.
checks.threshold: Any non-GBP order; GA4 currency != GBP
checks.known_today: Orders: all GBP (VERIFIED, 37 orders since 21 Aug). GA4 currency USD (Stage 1 section 16) - open HIGH.

checks.name: Revenue sanity
checks.query: FROM sales SHOW orders, gross_sales, discounts, returns, net_sales, shipping_charges, taxes, total_sales TIMESERIES day SINCE -1d UNTIL today
checks.logic: Each order total between £20 and £3,000 (swatches/boxes from £20; beds rarely above £1,000); sum of GraphQL order totals = ShopifyQL total_sales +/- £1; discounts <= 15% of gross (EAGLE10 is 10%).

checks.name: Missing product / variant ids on order lines
checks.query: orders(...) { nodes { name lineItems(first:20){ nodes{ title product{id} variant{id sku} } } } }
checks.logic: Ignore lines whose title ends ' - Selections' (Easify add-on lines, report separately). FAIL if product is null on any other line (HIGH); variant null (MEDIUM); sku null (LOW).
checks.known_today: #1009 variant null; sku null on #1043, #1042, #1013 (Grand Extra-Tall Panel, Curved Wingback, Hilton Wingback variants). VERIFIED 19 Nov.

checks.name: Broken or non-standard UTMs
checks.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions GROUP BY utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign SINCE -1d UNTIL today
checks.logic: For every row with any utm value: source and medium must be lowercase with no spaces or underscores, medium in [social, paid-social, email, cpc, referral, affiliate], campaign matches ^\d{4}-\d{2}-[a-z0-9-]+$ or ^ao-[a-z0-9-]+$. Rows whose (source, medium, campaign) are in the legacy/third-party allowlist in 04-utm-dq-model.md section 1.5 PASS. Also FAIL if utm_source is set but utm_medium is empty (except chatgpt.com).

checks.name: Untagged links on yesterday's posts
checks.query: ArtifactData query posts where date == <yesterday>; videos where date == <yesterday>; pins where postedAt == <yesterday>
checks.logic: For each item with status posted: every eaglebed.co.uk link in caption/facebookCaption/youtubeDescription/link must contain utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign. Instagram and TikTok captions without a URL ('Link in bio') PASS.
checks.known_today: Scheduled photo posts add 'Shop: <url>' with no UTM (task trig_01KWcB82NnwV2BbFQhQ3iuhL). 0 sessions with campaign hq_post_* in 90 days. VERIFIED.

checks.name: Tracking drop (UK human sessions and funnel)
checks.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_reached_checkout, sessions_that_completed_checkout WHERE human_or_bot_session = 'human' AND session_country = 'United Kingdom' TIMESERIES day SINCE -29d UNTIL today
checks.logic: Compare yesterday with the mean of the same weekday over the previous 4 weeks (closed days only).
checks.threshold: sessions = 0 -> CRITICAL; sessions -40% or more -> HIGH; cart sessions = 0 with >= 30 sessions -> HIGH; 0 orders for 7 days with sessions within 30% of normal -> CRITICAL
checks.alert: HQ card + daily report + owner push for CRITICAL

checks.name: Unattributed orders share
checks.query: orders(query:"created_at:>=<-14d>") { nodes { name customerJourneySummary { ready firstVisit{source} lastVisit{source} } } }
checks.logic: Share of orders with ready=true and firstVisit null (cookies declined / blocked).

checks.name: Checkout bot / probe spike
checks.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_reached_checkout SINCE -1d UNTIL today  (all sessions, no human filter) and the same with human_or_bot_session = 'human'
checks.logic: All-sessions reached_checkout > 3 x cart sessions AND > 30; or bot share of all sessions > 40%.

checks.name: Non-UK traffic share
checks.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions GROUP BY session_country WHERE human_or_bot_session = 'human' SINCE -7d UNTIL today
checks.logic: Share of human sessions outside the United Kingdom.

checks.name: Shopify vs GA4
checks.query: OpenRush get_website_analytics last 7 complete days: sessions, purchases (ecommerce purchases), purchase revenue, currency. Shopify: FROM sales SHOW orders, total_sales SINCE <same 7 days>; FROM sessions SHOW sessions WHERE human_or_bot_session = 'human'
checks.logic: GA4 purchases / Shopify web orders (excl. cancelled, draft orders). Normal: GA4 10-30% lower (consent, blockers). Revenue compared only when GA4 currency is GBP.
checks.threshold: GA4 purchases 0 while Shopify >= 2 -> HIGH; gap > 40% or GA4 > Shopify (double firing) -> HIGH; session trend direction differs from Shopify UK-human trend by > 25 points -> MEDIUM

checks.name: Shopify vs Google Ads
checks.source: OpenRush get_ad_performance (Google Ads) vs Shopify GraphQL customerJourneySummary
checks.query: OpenRush get_ad_performance last 7 complete days by campaign: cost, conversions, conversion value. Shopify: orders in the same 7 days whose firstVisit or lastVisit utmParameters.medium = 'cpc' and source = 'google'.
checks.logic: Ads conversions vs Shopify Ads-touched orders; Ads conversion value vs their Shopify totals; any conversion value < £5 (the £1.05 secondary action).
checks.threshold: Ads value > 1.3 x Shopify Ads-touched revenue -> HIGH (over-claim); Ads conversions 0 while Shopify has >= 2 Ads-touched orders -> HIGH; any conversion value < £5 -> MEDIUM; spend > 2x previous week -> CRITICAL (existing autopilot rule)
checks.optional: +3 credits get_ad_campaigns only if a campaign status/budget change is suspected

checks.name: Shopify vs Meta
checks.source: Meta Ads connector (ads_get_ad_entities, read-only, 0 OpenRush credits) vs ShopifyQL sessions
checks.query: Meta: account spend, link clicks, purchases, purchase value last 7 days. Shopify: FROM sessions SHOW sessions GROUP BY utm_source, utm_medium WHERE utm_source IN ('facebook','instagram') SINCE -7d UNTIL today; orders with Meta-touched journey.
checks.logic: If Meta spend > 0: Shopify paid-social sessions should be >= 50% of Meta link clicks; Meta purchases vs Shopify Meta-touched orders.
checks.threshold: Spend > £0 and Shopify paid-social sessions = 0 -> HIGH; sessions < 50% of link clicks -> MEDIUM; Meta purchases > 1.5 x Shopify Meta-touched orders -> MEDIUM. If spend = 0: SKIPPED (dormant since 8 Sep).

checks.name: Data freshness
checks.query: ArtifactData get dq latest; get model latest
checks.threshold: > 36 hours -> MEDIUM (the checks themselves did not run)
checks.frequency: daily (checked by the daily report task)
